description: Configuration for the two generalization evaluations requested in Task 5. No large-scale experiment has been run against this plan -- it specifies exactly how episode IDs, seeds, and splits should be constructed when it is executed.

shared_settings.episode_id_convention: {family_name}-ep-{seed}, e.g. 'A_uniform_random-ep-17'. This is a pure naming convention -- no change to DatasetExample or the dataset pipeline. It lets an episode's originating workload family be recovered from example.episode_id via a string prefix, which is all leave-one-family-out grouping needs.

seed_pool_per_family.note: Non-overlapping seed ranges per family so within-distribution and leave-one-family-out runs draw from disjoint episode pools and can be reproduced independently.

protocol_A_within_distribution.description: For each family independently: generate N episodes from that family's seed pool, split by episode ID (never by example) using the existing neuropager.experiment.split.split_episodes at the default 70/15/15 fractions, train/evaluate within that family only. Six independent within-distribution results, one per family.

protocol_B_leave_one_family_out.description: For each family F in the six: pool episodes from the OTHER five families for train+val (split 82/18 within that pool, i.e. 0.7/(0.7+0.15) train fraction of the non-test portion, so val comes only from the training families, never from F); test exclusively on F's own held-out episodes, never seen in train or val. Repeat once per family (6 runs total per model/horizon).

for_each_held_out_family.train_val_pool: episodes from the other 5 families (5 x 200 = 1000 episodes)
for_each_held_out_family.test_pool: all 200 episodes from the held-out family F, entirely unseen during training/validation

protocol_B_leave_one_family_out.implementation_note: Requires pooling DatasetExample lists from multiple families before calling split_episodes on the combined episode_id set (using the training families' IDs only), then filtering the held-out family's examples separately for the test set. No change to neuropager.dataset or neuropager.experiment needed -- this is caller-side orchestration only.
protocol_B_leave_one_family_out.runs_required: 6 held-out families x 5 horizons x 2 models = 60 train/eval runs, before this is executed at scale

estimated_scale_if_executed.total_episodes: 1200 (200 per family x 6 families), shared across both protocols via the same seed pools
estimated_scale_if_executed.total_train_eval_runs: protocol A: 6 families x 5 horizons x 2 models = 60; protocol B: 6 held-out families x 5 horizons x 2 models = 60; combined = 120
